title: Residency-aware encryption attestations aggregator for audit bundles
creator: Leah Park
description:
Problem: Customers and auditors require a single, cryptographically-signed audit bundle per tenant that proves: (1) which cryptographic keys were used to encrypt tenant data, (2) the residency of those keys at time windows, (3) rotation events and provenance for each wrapping key, and (4) that retention and deletion policies were enforced. Today we have scattered artifacts across KMS logs, HSM audit streams, residency attestation exports, and S3 retention lifecycle logs. There is no assembled, tamper-evident bundle that maps keys -> residency -> rotation -> dataset slices for an auditor report.

Goal: Implement an aggregator service that collects KMS/HSM rotation events, cross-references tenant key bindings and region residency, correlates with retention/deletion evidence, generates a time-bound signed attestation (bundled JSON + signature), and stores the bundle in a write-once location with audit metadata. The output should be usable by compliance teams and customers during audits and for regulatory evidence requests.
acceptance_criteria: Service ingests rotation events (KMS pub/sub) and HSM audit streams at 99% completeness for test window
Per-tenant bundles contain: key IDs, key versions, region of origin, rotation timestamps, operation log snippets (linkable), and retention confirmation for affected data objects
Bundles are signed by an internal signing key and exported to an immutable S3 prefix with versioned path per tenant
Ability to regenerate a bundle for an arbitrary time window (start/end) and compare with an existing bundle; mismatch flagged in the report
APIs for on-demand bundle download and a limited audit-view console entry accessible to Compliance role
End-to-end integration test with a simulated KMS rotation and a simulated retention-delete job that proves generated evidence contains correct references
tasks: Design: schema for evidence bundle (fields + provenance) — doc: confluence/redwood/evidence-bundle-schema (draft)
Ingest: build connector for KMS pub/sub (GCP/AWS) and normalized HSM audit-line parser
Correlate: implement key->tenant mapping service and residency resolver that uses tenancy metadata and region tags
Signer: integrate signing service (existing attestation-key signer) with HSM-backed signing when available
Storage: implement immutable export to S3 with lifecycle: retention 7 years, restricted ACLs, access logging
API: add endpoints for bundle generation, status, and download; wire RBAC to compliance group
E2E tests: synthetic rotation + retention pipeline in staging; assert bundle contents and signature validity
Docs: reviewer-facing runbook for auditors to validate bundles and for support to triage evidence mismatches
implementation_notes: We will reuse the attestation signer introduced in ENG-43120 where feasible but must add HSM-backed signing fallback for Private deployments. The ingestion pipeline will normalize timestamps to UTC and canonicalize key identifiers across cloud providers. Residency resolution must consult the tenant metadata service and cross-check with infra tags for edge cases (customers with multi-region tenancy). Bundles must include cryptographic hashes of referenced log artifacts (not the full logs) and signed manifest entries referencing stored log objects to keep bundle size bounded. Keep audit exports idempotent and include a monotonic sequence id in the bundle metadata.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): run aggregator on 7-day rolling window for internal tenants and verify signatures — 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-22
Phase 2 (pilot customers): enable for 3 enterprise customers with active compliance controls, collect feedback — 2026-03-23 to 2026-04-05
Phase 3 (GA): enable console access and API; update runbooks and compliance marketplace listing — target 2026-04-20
